findings.title: Unavailable FIFO head starves eligible tasks; reserve bypasses required capabilities
findings.reproduction: Authorize A with capabilities=[unavailable-capability] and B without requirements; catalog local capabilities=[]; reserve(B) returns False despite no active workers. reserve(A) returns True although no capable model exists.
findings.fix: Revalidate trusted catalog availability, target and capabilities atomically at reserve; FIFO priority applies only to currently eligible heads.

findings.title: inspect exposes other tenant task IDs and absolute worker paths
findings.reproduction: Reserve A in tenant one; register a new independent tenant actor and call inspect. environment.active contains A hash and absolute worker directory.
findings.fix: Preserve global occupancy through anonymous capacity counts, exposing resource identities only after tenant and current issue ACL checks.

findings.title: Producer terminal overwrites concurrent cancellation and permits done
findings.reproduction: Start fixture actual worker in Thread, wait native task running, transition_issue(cancelled), join. Run fixture independent check/approve/publish/complete.
findings.fix: Under terminal transaction revalidate current authorization, definition and cancellation. Persist true terminal independently while retaining stopped business state; never resurrect cancelled work.

findings.title: Revoked private fixed-input ACL is bypassed by worker materialization
findings.reproduction: Share private requirement source to editor, authorize public task with fixed selected a plus source module, revoke share. require_native_module_read denies, but reserve/execute materializes private snapshot.json.
findings.fix: Check current source ACL for every selected and transitive source-bound module at authorization, reserve, execution and acceptance; do not limit checks to issue ancestry.

findings.title: Event driver waits slowest batch before using free capacity or accepting fast output
findings.reproduction: Execute actual driveNative using installed dispatchEvent against deterministic service adapter with capacity=2, A gated promise, B immediate completion, independent C ready. B completion leaves C idle until external A gate release.
findings.fix: React to each genuine terminal independently, accepting output and refilling freed capacity without awaiting unrelated workers. Keep bounded concurrency and unknown occupancy.
findings.evidence_limit: Actual Node dispatch code with deterministic service adapter, not remote process performance measurement. Promise ordering establishes barrier; no wallclock threshold used as sole evidence.

findings.title: One failed outbox event prevents independent later events from advancing
findings.reproduction: Produce and independently accept A and B. Installed next_issues throws only for A; call advance twice. B resolver is never invoked.
findings.fix: Isolate failures per outbox event, preserve failed event pending with actionable error, continue independent events; partial child authorization must replay idempotently.

findings.title: Cancellation during independent review still changes selected release
findings.reproduction: Actual produced candidate/check; trusted review_candidate transitions issue to cancelled then returns True. publish returns content_selected; complete subsequently rejects.
findings.fix: Revalidate after long reviewer callback and guard current authorization/definition/dependencies/cancellation through actual native publication commit using consistent native-to-domain lock ordering; post-publication completion rejection is insufficient.
